The build machine is macOS 26.6 with Xcode 27.1, and the iOS simulator runtime is installed.

This breaks P1-B-01 ("a linked device reads history") on the real server; the demo backend hid it. Rows: P1-E1-w32-CR1 (B half), P1-B-01 (re-open the acceptance). Scope:
